Check:
- 149,90 TL -> 149.90
- 649,00 TL -> 649.00
- Total: 1098.70
- Return tutar: 149.90

Phone: 0532 412 77 19 -> Turkey mobile. E.164: +905324127719

The user said "YALNIZCA bir ```json bloğu ver (başka açıklama yazma)". So I should output only the code block with JSON, nothing else.

Make sure no markdown table, no extra text. Just the json block.

Looks good.
